summary: Full e2e test of the new David Astburys (/davidastburys) seller-direct funnel plus regression on /balgores, /exp and /. Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_da_seller_direct.py) covering POST /api/leads/order-survey with brand=davidastburys + flow=seller_direct (returns agreement_token + agreement_url ending /davidastburys/agreement/{tok}, email_error=null), GET /api/agreements/{token} echoing brand='davidastburys' (also for pre-existing preview token 6shviT64YAc), 422 guard for invalid brand 'davidastburys_uk', 422 guard for missing seller_email, backend _render_da_direct_order internal email template renders David Astburys + #9B2743 buttons on a white background (matches spec point 5), and public agreement response contains no em dash characters (agency/agent/property fields). Frontend: /davidastburys landing renders (data-testid='da-landing'), David Astburys logo present in header, hero headline 'London, meet how Scotland sells homes.' visible on the burgundy hero, section 2 'Fix survey problems before they break the sale' is white with dark text, section 3 'Why order your survey before you sell?' is burgundy with white text, sections after (Survey It. Reserve It., Nothing Upfront card, Professional Indemnity, Here's how it works) render on the #ccbfb9 background with dark text and remain readable. All four landing pages (/, /balgores, /exp, /davidastburys) render the new 3D imagery: brand-specific lock/lens/shield/house PNGs served from /brand-assets/*.png (all 200), no broken images. /davidastburys/pricing renders the calculator with the exact 'Enter property value' placeholder and produces GBP776 for value 725000 / 1to3 bedrooms / N-A (byte-identical band to /balgores). /davidastburys/order-survey completes the 4-step flow: step 3 branch selector data-testid='order-input-branch' offers exactly Crouch End, Islington, Hampstead (plus the 'Please select' guard), agent name/email are optional, step 4 uses 'Not provided' instead of an em dash for missing values. Submitting POST /api/leads/order-survey with flow=seller_direct + brand=davidastburys returns 200 + agreement_token and the SPA redirects to /davidastburys/agreement/{token}. The DA agreement page renders in the light theme with the sticky bottom action bar readable on the #ccbfb9 background, scrolling to agreement-sentinel unlocks Agree, the confirmation modal (with agreement-details-ok-checkbox + agreement-confirm-accept) gates the final POST /accept which returns 200 and the timeline updates to accepted. The Decline path opens a readable modal (heading 'Decline the survey terms?' dark on white, 'Go back' burgundy button with white label agreement-decline-back, agreement-confirm-decline visible), decline-accept moves timeline to declined and agreement-reopen brings it back to pending. Admin /admin login works, DA rows show data-testid='order-agent-label-{ref}' with text 'David Astburys . Crouch End|Islington|Hampstead' plus a DAVIDASTBURYS brand chip (span). Regression: /balgores, /exp and / landings load 200 with no console errors, all brand-specific 3D icons present, /balgores/order-survey still renders the branch step. All emails went only to vignesh.sasindran@gazeal.co.uk; SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, RPSA_WEBHOOK_URL and PM_RPSA_SAVE_URL remain blank in backend/.env (untouched).
critical_code_review_comments: The DA funnel was cloned from Balgores/eXp (order-survey-da.jsx, agreement-da.jsx plus 13 duplicated components under components/ui/da/). Any future clause / pricing / copy change now has to be made in 4 places. Strongly recommend consolidating the brand components behind a single theme-token prop before adding a 5th brand.

Pre-existing (not DA related) repo test failures remain from previous iterations: tests/test_slack_email_status.py (SENDER_EMAIL assertion), tests/test_email_and_interest.py (SENDER_EMAIL), tests/test_agreements.py::test_valid_token_returns_public_context (needs SAMPLE_AGREEMENT_TOKEN env), tests/test_balgores_seller_direct.py::test_accept_seller_direct_agreement (stale, predates risk_acknowledged) and tests/test_new_features.py / test_pricing_snapshot_and_package.py / test_sale_room_link.py posting /accept without risk_ack. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to the DA work.
